parts.name: TimeRangePickerRoot
parts.description: Holds the range and shares it, with the bounds, locale and the rest, with the two sides. A `role="group"`, named by its `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or an enclosing FieldLabel. With a name, or inside a FieldRoot, it renders the two hidden `<input type="time">`s that submit the range and that Field validates.

props.name: value
props.description: The range. `null` is controlled and empty; leaving it out lets the picker hold its own.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The range at first, when it isn't controlled. A form reset puts it back.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the whole range whenever either end changes (undefined while that end is empty or incomplete).

props.name: allowOvernight
props.description: Whether the end may be earlier than the start, a range across midnight.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest valid time, for both ends.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest valid time, for both ends.

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale of both fields and their popups.

props.name: granularity
props.description: The smallest unit of both times: `"hour"`, `"minute"` or `"second"`.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: `12` or `24` overrides the locale's hour cycle.

props.name: minuteStep
props.description: Minutes between the minute columns' options.

props.name: secondStep
props.description: Seconds between the second columns' options.

props.name: placeholderValue
props.description: What a choice starts from on a side with no time yet.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether neither side can be changed. Also true inside a disabled FieldRoot.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the fields can be focused but not changed; the triggers are disabled.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether both times are needed for the form to be valid.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the range as `<name>-start` and `<name>-end`. Taken from an enclosing FieldRoot when not given.

props.name: startName
props.description: The start time's name with a form.

props.name: endName
props.description: The end time's name with a form.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of a `<form>` the hidden inputs belong to.

props.name: incompleteMessage
props.description: The validation message while a side is partly filled.

props.name: rangeOrderMessage
props.default: "The end time is before the start time."
props.description: The validation message for an end before the start (unless `allowOvernight`).

dataAttributes.name: data-dirty
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field's value has changed.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the range is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-filled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field has a value.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the field has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the end is before the start (and `allowOvernight` is off), a side is outside `min`/`max` or partly filled, or the FieldRoot around it is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-touched
dataAttributes.description: Present once the field has been focused and left.

dataAttributes.name: data-valid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is valid.

parts.name: TimeRangePickerStart
parts.description: The start: a TimePickerRoot for the range's start, bounded above by the end unless `allowOvernight`. Inside it go the Time Picker's parts (TimePickerField, TimePickerTrigger, TimePickerPopup and its columns). Its field submits `<name>-start`.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether this side's popup is open.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether this side's popup is open at first, when it isn't controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called after this side's popup opens or closes.

parts.name: TimeRangePickerEnd
parts.description: The end: a TimePickerRoot for the range's end, bounded below by the start unless `allowOvernight`, so its popup disables what would put it earlier. Its field submits `<name>-end`.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether this side's popup is open.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether this side's popup is open at first, when it isn't controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called after this side's popup opens or closes.

parts.name: TimeRangePickerSeparator
parts.description: A span between the two sides, hidden from assistive technology (each field has its own name). Its text is yours: "–", "to".
